title: Kbox 沙箱、观测与干预统一架构
status: Current working-tree architecture analysis and integrated diagram. Runtime and external integrations are not qualified.
source_scope: Architectural entry points and contracts referenced by sandbox-control.md. Working-tree SHA-256 includes unrelated uncommitted changes. Digests and visual checks do not prove runtime behavior.
delivery_contract: One integrated architecture diagram and one detailed document. Use the original Harness layered-card visual language. Diagram content is limited to components, ownership, isolation choices, signals and control paths. No sequence or HTML deliverable.

visual_style.fonts: System sans-serif with PingFang SC / Noto Sans CJK SC fallbacks
visual_style.structure: Rounded cards, dashed responsibility groups, left execution layers, right Sentry plane and bottom human controls

kernel_boundaries: Process command sandbox may share host kernel (external ksandbox)
Box product path: Independent guest kernel / DedicatedVm MicroVM only

isolation_scope.process_command: One command and descendants; implemented by external https://github.com/kense-labs/ksandbox (ksandbox). Native backends may share the host kernel. Core may also execute a command in a VM.
isolation_scope.code_environment: Box owns an image-based MicroVM runtime environment with exactly one hardware isolation boundary: ExecutionBoundary::Microvm mapped to OCI DedicatedVm. The request model has no isolation selector; retired selectors are rejected explicitly. Shared-host-kernel sandboxing is not a kbox Box product route.
isolation_scope.dedicated_vm: Independent guest kernel; OCI route maps Microvm to DedicatedVm. Box isolation product = dedicated-kernel MicroVM only.

integration_boundaries.sentry: ksentry security engine, separate from error-reporting Sentry SDK
integration_boundaries.observer: External Linux collector/guards; source is absent from this checkout. Relations come from the local event parser, Enforcer and reference deployment, not a live guard test.
integration_boundaries.gateway: wire Cargo feature and configured guardrails or dedicated Wire route are required
integration_boundaries.sae: SDK/host explicitly composes SAE Pipeline. Power has encoder and event emitter; production backend/TEE activation is not established.
integration_boundaries.host_intervention: Manual Core/Box controls exist; no unified Sentry-to-Core/Box automatic stop adapter is claimed
integration_boundaries.enforcement: block decision, deny-file write, guard reload and kernel refusal are distinct states
